description.zh: 巡夜交班前，碎蜂听见檐铃多响了一声。她把半掩的窗推开一指宽，沿着屋脊走到风口，发现拴铃的结已经松了。
description.en: One extra chime catches Soi Fon’s ear at the end of the night watch. She opens a window a finger’s width, crosses the roof and finds a loose knot on the wind bell.

editorial.storyZh: 巡夜交班前，碎蜂听见檐铃多响了一声。她把半掩的窗推开一指宽，沿着屋脊走到风口，发现拴铃的结已经松了。她没有惊动院里的新队士，俯身把绳结重新收紧，又退回刚才的位置等了一阵风。第二次掠过屋檐时，瓦片一点声音也没有。天亮后，值班的人只发现铃绳上多了一个极小的结。她回到值房，把原先写着风向的那页翻出来，添上巡查经过的时辰。等纸上的墨迹干透，院里的新人也已经睡熟了。金色指刺贴合右手，身旁闪出一枚蝶形蜂纹华图样。
editorial.storyEn: One extra chime catches Soi Fon’s ear at the end of the night watch. She opens a window a finger’s width, crosses the roof and finds a loose knot on the wind bell. She tightens it without waking the recruit below and waits for another gust before returning. At dawn, the only sign of her visit is a neatly doubled knot. Back in the guardroom she adds the time to the weather log. By the time the ink dries, the recruit is asleep. A gold stinger fits over her right middle finger. A butterfly-shaped Homonka emblem flickers beside her.
